executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 43 errors due to missing dependencies in pom.xml. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages cannot be found. Add the missing dependencies to pom.xml to resolve all compilation errors.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be resolved including HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. JpaRepository, Modifying, Query, and Param annotations cannot be resolved across multiple repository files.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity, Table, Id, and other JPA annotations cannot be resolved in entity classes.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure jakarta.persistence-api is included (typically provided by spring-boot-starter-data-jpa). If not, add explicitly: <dependency><groupId>jakarta.persistence</groupId><artifactId>jakarta.persistence-api</artifactId></dependency>

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml. StringUtils and other utility classes cannot be resolved.
